description: Open war with the Dominion drives the Federation from DS9 and back again, forcing Sisko's crew through occupation, battlefield compromise and moral choices that become darker as victory grows more expensive.

s06e01.description: With DS9 occupied, Sisko's crew uses a captured Jem'Hadar ship to strike a critical ketracel-white facility behind enemy lines.

s06e02.description: Sisko's stranded crew faces equally marooned Jem'Hadar while Kira begins recognizing the compromises of living under Dominion occupation.

s06e03.description: Worf struggles when Alexander joins Martok's crew, while Ziyal returns to occupied DS9 and complicates Dukat's relationship with Kira.

s06e04.description: Kira's resistance exploits tension between Cardassians and Jem'Hadar until the Female Changeling's arrival draws Odo away from the cause.

s06e05.description: Sisko persuades Starfleet to retake DS9 while Kira's resistance races to prevent Dominion control of the wormhole.

s06e06.description: The Federation fleet attacks for DS9 as the minefield falls and Sisko races toward a Dominion force waiting beyond the wormhole.

s06e07.description: Worf and Dax rush toward a Klingon wedding whose rituals test both the groom's endurance and the bride's relationship with her new family.

s06e08.description: The mirror-universe Bareil arrives on DS9 and rekindles Kira's feelings, though his motives for crossing universes are not entirely personal.

s06e09.description: Bashir asks a group of genetically enhanced patients to analyze the Dominion War, but their cold projections challenge the value of continuing resistance.

s06e10.description: Quark assembles an improbably Ferengi rescue team to recover his captured mother from the Dominion on Empok Nor.

s06e11.description: Sisko is stranded with an increasingly unstable Dukat, whose self-justifications collapse as the two wait for rescue.

s06e12.description: Morn is reported dead and leaves Quark an inheritance that attracts several dangerous people from his hidden past.

s06e13.description: A discouraged Sisko experiences the life of a Black science-fiction writer in 1950s America fighting to publish a story about Deep Space Nine.

s06e14.description: A miniaturized runabout carrying Dax, Bashir and O'Brien becomes the crew's unlikely advantage after Jem'Hadar seize the Defiant.

s06e15.description: O'Brien infiltrates the Orion Syndicate and becomes close to the criminal he has been ordered to betray.

s06e16.description: Worf must choose between completing a critical mission and saving Dax after she is wounded deep inside Dominion territory.

s06e17.description: Dukat's revelation about Kira's mother sends Kira into the past, where she discovers an uncomfortable truth about her family's Occupation history.

s06e18.description: A relentless investigation into Bashir's supposed Dominion ties reveals a secret Federation organization operating beyond ordinary accountability.

s06e19.description: Sisko and Garak pursue a morally corrosive plan to bring the Romulans into the war against the Dominion.

s06e20.description: Vic Fontaine helps Odo stop hiding behind caution and finally confront the romantic possibility he has avoided with Kira.

s06e21.description: An ancient tablet releases a Prophet and a Pah-wraith who choose Kira and Jake as vessels for a battle that could determine Bajor's future.

s06e22.description: Jake and Nog are rescued by a Defiant-class ship crewed by elite cadets whose confidence drives them toward an impossible target.

s06e23.description: Quark assumes a female identity to help Zek defend reforms granting Ferengi women new economic rights.

s06e24.description: Molly O'Brien falls through a time portal and returns as an isolated young adult shaped by years alone in the past.

s06e25.description: Defiant's crew races toward a stranded Starfleet captain while sustaining her through radio conversations that grow unexpectedly personal.

s06e26.description: Sisko leads an invasion of Cardassian space despite a prophetic warning, while Dukat returns with a plan to strike at Bajor's gods.
